name: linkedin-mcp
description: Claude plugin and MCP server for LinkedIn: publish and manage posts, comments and reactions, manage company pages, read analytics and build job searches through LinkedIn's official API.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --minify --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
